summary:
Dancing with the SARs – NISAR EarthWatch is an interactive web-based platform developed using NASA-ISRO's NISAR satellite mission. Its main objective is to make satellite radar observations accessible and understandable through an interactive 3D globe, before-and-after SAR image comparison, and multilingual voice assistance.

The platform uses NASA's L-band and ISRO's S-band radar technologies to monitor environmental changes in different regions. It focuses on four major locations: Brahmaputra for flood monitoring, Coimbatore for agricultural observation, Ridgecrest for earthquake-related ground movements, and Everglades for wetland ecosystem monitoring.

Its key features include smart location search, satellite orbital visualization, multi-temporal SAR comparison, backscatter analysis, and surface displacement monitoring. The multilingual voice assistant supports Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu, Hindi, and English, helping users understand complex satellite information through simple audio explanations.

This project aims to support farmers, researchers, disaster management teams, and local communities by transforming advanced satellite data into meaningful environmental insights. Our vision is to democratize space technology and make Earth observation accessible to everyone.
details:
Dancing with the SARs – NISAR EarthWatch is an interactive web-based platform designed to make satellite radar observations easier to understand and accessible to everyone. Our project is based on NASA and ISRO's NISAR mission, which uses L-band and S-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) technology to monitor changes on Earth's surface.

The platform features an interactive 3D Earth globe with smart location search, allowing users to explore important geographical regions. It focuses on four major monitoring locations: Brahmaputra for flood detection, Coimbatore for agricultural monitoring, Ridgecrest for earthquake-related ground movements, and Everglades for wetland ecosystem observation.

One of our major features is the Before-and-After SAR Image Comparison, which helps users identify environmental changes between different observation dates. It also includes backscatter difference analysis, coherence changes, and surface displacement monitoring to demonstrate how radar observations can reveal changes on Earth even under cloudy conditions or at night.

Another innovative feature is our multilingual voice assistant, supporting Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu, Hindi, and English. Users can navigate locations through voice commands and receive simplified audio explanations of complex satellite observations. This makes scientific information more accessible to local communities, farmers, researchers, and disaster management teams.

Our project's creativity lies in combining dual-band SAR technology, interactive 3D visualization, multi-temporal comparison, and multilingual voice intelligence into a single platform. We considered accessibility, usability, geographical diversity, environmental applications, and the importance of communicating scientific information in regional languages.

The project is developed as a web-based application and deployed on Netlify. Its intended impact is to bridge the gap between advanced space technology and everyday users by transforming satellite observations into understandable environmental insights. Our ultimate goal is to democratize Earth observation and support better environmental awareness, research, and disaster preparedness.
